evidence.excerpt:
* ⚠️ Remove 3rd party lua plugin support (#11821) ⚠️

  This removes the following configuration options:

  * `plugins`

  It also removes support for user provided Lua plugins in the `/etc/nginx/lua/plugins` directory.
